epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local environment setup time from >10 mins to <1 min
epics.tocConstraintRef: bottleneck in local deployment and verification
requirements: R1: Add docker-compose.yml at repository root to start the full stack and expose a health-check endpoint

slices.title: Add docker-compose for full stack deployment
slices.jtbd: When implementing full stack deployment for this epic, I want to create a docker-compose configuration, so that the product can be verified locally.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When a developer runs docker-compose up, Then the backend and frontend start successfully.
Given the running stack, When a health-check is requested, Then a success response is returned.
Given the new docker-compose file, When the test suite runs, Then integration tests verify the health-check endpoint.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce local setup time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce time to correct material data from >5 mins to <1 min
requirements: R1: Enable update and delete actions for materials in the UI

slices.title: Patch existing UI to support update and delete actions
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management for this epic, I want to expose update and delete actions in the existing UI, so that outdated entries can be corrected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material, When a user clicks edit and saves, Then the PUT API is invoked and UI updates.
Given an existing material, When a user clicks delete and confirms, Then the DELETE API is invoked and UI updates.
Given the new UI actions, When E2E tests run, Then the update and delete workflows pass successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce manual DB corrections from >5 per week to 0

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthorized access incidents from unmeasured to 0
epics.tocConstraintRef: bottleneck in system security and access control
requirements: R1: Enforce authentication mechanism to protect catalog access

slices.title: Enable existing authentication mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to patch the existing code to enforce access control, so that unauthenticated access is blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog, Then they are blocked.
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to create a material, Then they are prompted to log in.
Given the updated access controls, When security integration tests run, Then unauthorized access attempts are rejected.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce unauthenticated API access from 100% to 0%
